summary: Tested the new one-screen Dashboard replacement (scanner table, 5/5 ready-to-trade panel, 2x2 chart grid, news feed) plus backend endpoints for large-trades/10Sec bars/news, and regression-checked Trading/Settings/History/Missed pages + full pytest suite. Core dashboard UX works well: scan-toggle triggers real ~65s scans, 108 scanner rows rendered with real price/%/RVol/float/criteria-dot data, flame badges (breaking/warm/cold) render correctly on rows with news, row click sets selected-symbol-header + highlight state, chart grid + news feed correctly switch when a different row is clicked (no stale data leak), 1Day chart renders real candlesticks with SMA20/SMA50/VWAP overlays, 10Sec tile shows the expected graceful 'no ticks yet' message (MARKET_STREAM_ENABLED=false in this env, as documented - not a bug). HOWEVER found one CRITICAL regression: 1Min and 5Min chart tiles ALWAYS fail with a real backend AttributeError ('MarketDataStreamManager' object has no attribute 'merge_with_stream') instead of showing real REST-fallback data as expected - confirmed via direct API call and reproduced in the browser on every symbol tested (RIBBU, XAIR). Root cause found in code review: services/market_data_stream_service.py has an orphaned code block (lines ~420-458) that is clearly meant to be a `merge_with_stream` method body (docstring + logic referencing rest_bars/timeframe/limit), but the `def merge_with_stream(self, symbol, rest_bars, timeframe, limit=100):` line itself is missing - the block is dead/unreachable code sitting after `return` inside `get_large_trades()` instead of being its own method. server.py calls `market_data_stream.merge_with_stream(...)` which doesn't exist as an attribute, causing every 1Min/5Min bars request to raise AttributeError (caught by the broad except and returned as a 200 with a confusing 'no_historical_data' + raw Python error message shown directly to the user in the chart tile).

critical.issue: AttributeError: 'MarketDataStreamManager' object has no attribute 'merge_with_stream' - the method's `def` line is missing in services/market_data_stream_service.py (its body, lines ~420-458, is orphaned dead code sitting unreachable after the `return` statement inside get_large_trades() instead of being its own method). Every 1Min/5Min bars call fails and falls into the broad except-block, returning a 200 with no_historical_data=true and the raw exception string shown as the warning message - directly surfaced to end users in the ChartGrid's 1Min/5Min tiles. This breaks 2 of the 4 required chart-grid timeframes and contradicts the expectation that 1Min/5Min should use the normal REST fallback and show real data.

minor.issue: 502 gateway timeout - matches the documented known preview-environment-only issue (full scans ~60-65s occasionally exceed ~60s ingress timeout on endpoints synchronously awaiting a scan). Not a new regression.

ui_bugs.issue: Displays raw backend exception text ('No real historical data available for {symbol}: \'MarketDataStreamManager\' object has no attribute \'merge_with_stream\'') directly to the user instead of a chart or a clean 'no data' message - caused by the backend bug above.

action_items: Fix services/market_data_stream_service.py: add back the missing `def merge_with_stream(self, symbol, rest_bars, timeframe, limit=100):` line before the orphaned docstring/body currently sitting dead-code after get_large_trades()'s return statement (around line 419-420). This will restore 1Min/5Min real chart data via the REST fallback+stream-merge path.
After fixing, re-verify GET /api/market/bars/AAPL?timeframe=1Min and 5Min return real bars with source != 'none', and re-check the ChartGrid 1Min/5Min tiles render candlesticks in the browser.

No other action items - all other scoped dashboard features (scanner table, flame badges, 5/5 panel, row selection/switching, news feed, 10Sec/1Day tiles, account strip, stream indicator) and regression areas (Trading/Settings/History/Missed pages) verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: MiniChartTile.js and ChartGrid.js: clean, well-scoped components; correctly avoid fetching until a symbol is selected, per-timeframe refresh cadence is sensible.
ScannerCells.js NewsFlame component correctly gates on both hasNews and a valid freshness key - good defensive coding.

server.py get_bars() has a good design decision documented in comments: returns 200 with no_historical_data instead of 502 to avoid Cloudflare's HTML-error-page interception of 502s - however this same broad except also swallows the merge_with_stream AttributeError and surfaces the raw Python exception string to the end user, which is a debug leak / poor UX even once the underlying bug is fixed as a general design point.

market_data_stream_service.py: get_large_trades() and the orphaned merge_with_stream body are concatenated under one method due to a missing def line - clear copy/paste or refactor artifact, easy one-line fix.

success_rate.backend: ~93% (105 passed, 2 pre-existing documented gateway-timeout failures, 2 NEW failures caused by the merge_with_stream bug found this session)
success_rate.frontend: ~90% of scoped dashboard flows verified working; 1Min/5Min chart tiles broken due to the backend bug

context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard replacement is largely complete and working: scan-toggle -> ~65s real scan -> 108 rows with real data, flame badges (breaking/warm/cold) verified on RIBBU/GSRFR/EGHAU, row click sets selected-symbol-header, highlights row, switches chart grid + news feed correctly with no stale-data leak (verified RIBBU->XAIR switch), 1Day chart shows real candles+SMA20/SMA50/VWAP, 10Sec gracefully shows 'no ticks yet' (expected, MARKET_STREAM_ENABLED=false in this env). ONE CRITICAL BUG blocks 1Min/5Min tiles: missing `def merge_with_stream(...)` line in market_data_stream_service.py causes AttributeError on every 1Min/5Min bars call, surfaced as a raw exception string in the chart tile UI. This is a simple one-line fix (restore the def signature) - once fixed, next agent should re-verify 1Min/5Min tiles render real candlestick data for a selected symbol, and re-run tests/test_chart_bars_fix.py::TestBarsLimitCorrectness which currently fails for the same reason. Ready-to-trade panel had 0 candidates during this test run (real-time market condition, not a bug - after-hours, market closed per Trading page banner). Full backend pytest suite: 105 passed / 2 skipped / 4 failed (2 of the 4 are the new merge_with_stream bug, 2 are the pre-existing documented gateway-timeout issue, not new).
rca_of_the_issue: In services/market_data_stream_service.py, the class has get_tick_bars(), get_large_trades(), then what should be a third method merge_with_stream() - but its `def merge_with_stream(self, symbol, rest_bars, timeframe, limit=100):` signature line was deleted/never added, so its docstring+body (lines ~420-458) sit as unreachable code physically inside get_large_trades() (after its own return statement), NOT as a separate callable method on the class. When server.py's GET /api/market/bars/{symbol} handler calls `market_data_stream.merge_with_stream(symbol, result.get('bars', []), timeframe, limit)` for timeframe in [1Min, 5Min], Python raises AttributeError since no such method exists on the instance. This is caught by the broad `except Exception as e` in the endpoint, which returns HTTP 200 with `no_historical_data: true` and the raw exception text as the `warning` field - which the frontend's MiniChartTile then displays verbatim to the user in place of a chart.
